question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **together**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Together **means in proximity, union, or collaboration with others; in a collective or united manner. (एक साथ)

 
 
• **Example**: *We decided to work together on the project to achieve better results.*
 
 
 
• In the given context, "**together**" is fitting in this context as it encapsulates the essence of shared experiences and mutual engagement in the true friendship described in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simultaneously: **At the same time; occurring concurrently. (एक ही समय पर)
 
• **Jointly: **In collaboration or partnership with others; shared. (संयुक्त रूप से)
 
• **Collectively: **In a group or as a whole; involving all members of a group. (सम्मिलित रूप से)
